paper.core_task: Enhancing multiturn human-LLM collaboration for long-term interaction

contributions.name: A multiturn-aware reward framework for LLM training
contributions.author_claim_text: Its key innovation is a collaborative simulation that estimates the long-term contribution of responses using Multiturn-aware Rewards.
contributions.description: A training framework that estimates the long-term impact of model responses via collaborative simulation, using both extrinsic and intrinsic metrics to form multiturn-aware rewards.

contributions.name: A collaborative simulation module for forward sampling
contributions.author_claim_text: We introduce a collaborative simulation module that samples future conversations with users to estimate the long-term impact of model responses across multiple turns.
contributions.description: A module that samples possible future conversations with a user simulator to compute the expected long-term reward of a response, enabling forward-looking behavior.

contributions.name: A multiturn interaction benchmark with three tasks
contributions.author_claim_text: We also devise a multiturn interaction benchmark with three challenging tasks such as document creation.
contributions.description: A new benchmark comprising three multiturn tasks—document editing, code generation, and math problem solving—for evaluating collaborative LLM performance.

novelty_claims.text: The novelty is somewhat diluted by the absence of a thorough comparison to existing multiturn frameworks.
